custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'bubble' classification. Real soap bubbles almost always show some form of thin-film interference colors (swirls of pink/green/blue). If the classifier confirms 'bubble' despite the lack of color, note this as a potential false positive or a very specific lighting condition. However, prioritize the visual evidence: if it looks like clear glass, penalize alignment. Also, scrutinize the hand holding the wand for fusion artifacts.
